text_simplified:
A parent concludes his efforts by asking Allah by His Most Beautiful Names and Exalted Attributes to rectify intentions and offspring, and protect them from misleading trials.
Along with keeping in mind the ten pillars of raising children: (1) choosing a righteous spouse, (2) instilling creed and faith, (3) abundant supplication for children, (4) seeking lawful provision, (5) adorning oneself with noble character, (6) justice among children, (7) gentleness and mercy, (8) sincere advice and guidance, (9) choosing righteous companions, and (10) setting a righteous example.
